verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI325X is a data-center GPU accelerator with a supporting software stack (ROCm, SMI, schedulers, Kubernetes tooling). It has no user-facing application layer where AI-generated insights about a user's data would appear, so this story's axis does not fit the product type. Nothing in the pack shows such a feature: the 'AI-native' Spur scheduler handles job scheduling, not data insights.
